description: Embedded SQLite database tools for structured agent memory and SQL queries.
systemExtension: Use 'init_db' to initialize the local memory database. Use 'insert_fact' or 'insert_code_note' to store structured observations. Use 'query_db' to run SQL queries. Use runtime primitives (read_file, write_file) for workspace files and reports.

tools.description: Initialize the SQLite memory database schema with tables for facts and code notes.
tools.inputSchemaJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"db_path":{"type":"string","description":"Optional path to SQLite database, defaults to /tmp/agent_memory.db"}}}
tools.name: init_db

tools.description: Insert a structured fact (key, value, category) into the SQLite database.
tools.inputSchemaJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string","description":"Category of fact (e.g. architecture, dependency, config)"},"key":{"type":"string","description":"Unique fact identifier/key"},"value":{"type":"string","description":"The fact value or description"}},"required":["category","key","value"]}
tools.name: insert_fact

tools.description: Store a code analysis finding or observation into the SQLite database.
tools.inputSchemaJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"filepath":{"type":"string","description":"Relative path of the source file"},"snippet":{"type":"string","description":"Code snippet referenced"},"analysis":{"type":"string","description":"Analysis summary or explanation"},"severity":{"type":"string","description":"Severity: info, warning, error, or critical"}},"required":["filepath","analysis"]}
tools.name: insert_code_note

tools.description: Execute a SQL SELECT query against the SQLite memory database and return rows as JSON.
tools.name: query_db
